title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Westfield Sleep Clinic under your health plan for services provided on July 20, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
We denied this claim as an exact duplicate of a previously submitted claim. Reason code: CO-18.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $2,441.63 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $2,441.63.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: Your written appeal must be received by March 2, 2027. Send it to Tamsin Health Partners, Appeals Unit, PO Box 68992, Savannah, GA 31401. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-0964.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
